meta.name: Fixed extension degree · classical heuristic
meta.instance: finite fields of arbitrary fixed extension degree
meta.regime: Q=p^n with n fixed and p growing
meta.rules: NFS over a fixed-degree extension field. Includes the complete general-input discrete logarithm computation. Here L_X[α,c] = exp((c+o(1))(ln X)^α(ln ln X)^(1−α)); all logarithms in this definition are natural. Only compare entries with this cost scale, input domain and computational model. Polynomial and quasi-polynomial expressions without an extracted scalar are not ranked.
